updates.message: Plenty more PCs, so many PCs. Plus a bunch of old laptops! Overall though, nothing spectacular but relatively active.
This time around was pretty uneventful. Seems like there may have been more film, though!
Just a bunch of (taken apart) CD drives. Also only one box?
There's some Sun Microsystems server-looking computers filling the box, and a bunch of wires including phone wires and what looks like ethernet cables.
The boxes are still pretty full from before break, most of the stuff from then is still there. There is a xerox photocopier precariously inside the boxes now, though!
Quite surprising to see Cogswell getting some action, finds of the week this time!
Some wires and an old looking printer make up most of what's in here today.
In West, printers, string lights, a DVD player (find of the week last semester?). There's an AC unit, some trashed laptops, and a smashed flatscreen TV. Lots of wires, too.
There's a printer and 3 network switches.
